site_notes_do_not_paste.why_2_to_1: ModuleCard (src/components/content/ModuleCard.tsx) shows the image in a fixed 120px tall panel with object-cover, centred. Panel width changes with the grid: 272px at 1520px+ (5 columns, ratio 2.27:1), 172px at 1024px (1.44:1), about 335 to 460px below 1024px (2.8:1 to 3.8:1). A 2:1 master is cropped at most to about 72 percent of its width (narrow desktop) or about 52 percent of its height (two-column tablet).
site_notes_do_not_paste.safe_zone: Keep the focal subject inside x 15 to 85 percent and y 25 to 75 percent of the master. Nothing important near the edges.
site_notes_do_not_paste.scrim_and_numeral: The thumb scrim (--scrim-thumb) darkens the lower 60 percent of the panel (85 percent navy at the bottom), and the 22px module numeral sits bottom-left (10px from the left, 8px from the bottom). Keep the lower-left painted but dark and quiet.
site_notes_do_not_paste.generator_fallback: If the generator has no 2:1, make 16:9 (or 3:2) and centre-crop to 1600x800; the subject stays in the middle so nothing is lost.
site_notes_do_not_paste.consistency: All ten share one medium (oil painting), one light (warm gold on navy) and one accent rule (the module hue at about 15 percent, from the table: 01 #55a2ce, 02 #8394d6, 03 #c88859, 04 #38abb1, 05 #cf7f7f, 06 #c47fa7, 07 #56ac88, 08 #a987c8, 09 #86a460, 10 #ae964a). Gold stays the only action colour, so never paint gold UI-like shapes (buttons, frames).
site_notes_do_not_paste.people: Only 02 (de Gaulle) and 05 (Mbappé) have a face; 06 is a figure from behind. 01 is the submarine alone, and 10 shows the Rafale alone, so the two military modules do not repeat each other.
site_notes_do_not_paste.wiring: Not applied yet. MatrixSection.tsx does not pass imageSrc to ModuleCard. Once the ten files exist, pass imageSrc={`/images/thumb-${m.id}.jpg`} there (one line). Without it the cards stay typographic.
site_notes_do_not_paste.credits: Each new file needs a row in public/images/CREDITS.md (source: AI generated, generator and date, real pixels, status). The six existing thumb-*.jpg are 109x55 PNG data with a .jpg extension: overwrite them with the real JPEG of the same name.
site_notes_do_not_paste.canon: No R.I.F. figures appear in any image, so nothing needs the scenario marker.
